summary: Hudson Pacific Properties, L.P. and affiliates disclosed an Extension and Loan Modification Agreement dated September 9, 2026 with Wilmington Trust, as trustee for BXHPP Trust 2021-Film CMBS holders, amending the August 2021 $1.1 billion CMBS mortgage financing on the co-owned Hollywood Media Portfolio. The 8-K, furnished under Items 7.01 and 8.01 with a press release, extends and modifies loan terms. No price, stake, or premium terms were stated; the transaction addresses maturity/performance issues for a leveraged landlord. Watch for extension length, covenant relief, paydown or reserve requirements, and any equity cure or recapitalization implications.
